headline: ARI @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 4.59 at STL 4.81, with a projected total of 9.40. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (ARI +0.67, STL +0.65), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +1.31, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Andre Pallante has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alec Burleson, Gabriel Moreno, Ketel Marte, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ildemaro Vargas, Jorge Barrosa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
